answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because meadow only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, quill is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any ivory approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
